Volkswagen Golf 5 (Mk5 / 1K, 2004-2008)

Updated 24 November 2026

Yes: VAG Scope supports the Volkswagen Golf 5 (Mk5 / 1K, 2004-2008) over CAN TP 2.0 with an open Bluetooth ELM327 adapter, 100% offline. Where generic OBD-II apps only see basic engine emissions, VAG Scope reads all TP 2.0 control units, measuring blocks, coding and adaptations from your phone.

Where is the OBD-II port?

Look in the driver's footwell on the left side, just above the bonnet release lever behind the lower dash trim (no cover to unclip on most LHD and RHD cars).

Mileage & VIN check on this generation

On 2004-2008 PQ35 TP 2.0 cars, many control units do not expose a standalone odometer block, though the instrument cluster, EDC16 diesel ECU and fault-code freeze frames often record distance. VAG Scope compares whatever units answer and shows the evidence, though agreement is only one clue alongside service invoices and MOT/inspection history. Read the mileage check guide · VIN check guide

What to check before buying or maintaining

  • Scan the 02 Transmission (DQ250 6-speed DSG) and 01 Engine units for mechatronic pressure faults, clutch temperature warnings or misfire counters on 2.0 TFSI and 1.4 TSI engines.
  • Check 03 ABS/ESP for the well-known G201 brake pressure sensor fault on Teves MK60 units, which often triggers a permanent ESP light.
  • On 1.9 TDI and 2.0 TDI (PD / early DPF) engines, inspect injector deviation blocks and soot loading in measuring blocks while the engine idles warm.
  • Read 46 Central Convenience and 09 Central Electronics for door-lock microswitch faults, rear wiper motor errors or gateway battery-drain issues after aftermarket head-unit swaps.

What VAG Scope supports on this chassis

Full CAN TP 2.0 across engine, DSG, ABS, instrument cluster and comfort units. Generic OBD apps miss almost every module on a Mk5.

  • Pre-purchase health check: fault codes, cross-module mileage comparison and VIN check in one signed PDF report.
  • Full control-unit scan, advanced identification and fault clearing with automatic backup and confirmation.
  • Searchable live data (measuring blocks / UDS DIDs), 60-second charts, CSV logging and Android Auto dashboards.
  • Performance Hub: 0-500 km/h timing (100 Hz OBD + phone IMU fusion), virtual dyno, JPG cards and signed PDF run sheets, without GPS permission.
  • Coding, long coding, gateway installation list, adaptations, basic settings, output tests and service reset with automatic backup and read-back.

Frequently asked questions

Where is the OBD-II port on a VW Golf 5?

It sits in the driver's footwell under the lower dashboard trim, on the outer left side above the bonnet release handle.

Why do cheap ELM327 clones fail on a Golf 5?

The Golf 5 uses VW's CAN TP 2.0 transport protocol, which needs continuous keep-alive timing and raw CAN filtering. Cheap v2.1 clones drop the channel mid-scan; a vLinker MC+ or vGate iCar Pro 2S holds TP 2.0 cleanly.

Can VAG Scope code a Golf 5 without a Windows laptop?

Yes. Short coding, long coding, adaptations, basic settings, output tests and service interval resets run directly on your phone over Bluetooth, with an automatic backup and read-back after confirmation.

How many modules store mileage on a Golf 5?

Fewer than on newer MQB cars: the cluster, certain TDI ECUs and fault freeze frames may store distance, while some petrol ECUs report none. If the app says data are limited, lean on service records and inspection history.
